protocol.name: nidara_layers_v1

description.summary: layers the compositor animates for the client

protocol.description:
A layer is a wl_subsurface whose position, scale and opacity the compositor animates on its own: the client says where the layer ends and how it gets there, and the compositor moves it, frame by frame, whatever the client is doing — also while it commits nothing at all.
Only what has to move by itself is a layer. A widget is not a surface: static content is painted together into its parent's buffer.
The compositor owns the PRESENTED values (where a layer is on screen), the client the MODEL values (where it ends). Input is delivered where a layer is presented: the compositor hit-tests layers at their presented transform and gives pointer coordinates in the layer's own space, and maps a text-input cursor rectangle of the layer's surface the same way.
Phase 0 draft (#818, toolkit/CONTRACT.md). It stays at version 1 until it is published: requests are appended, never versioned.

entry.name: not_subsurface
entry.summary: the surface has no wl_subsurface role

entry.name: already_layer
entry.summary: the surface already has a layer object

entry.name: too_many_layers
entry.summary: more than 64 layers under one toplevel

entry.name: invalid_cursor
entry.summary: cursor layer is not under the root or rectangle has non-positive size

request.name: get_layer
request.description: The surface must have the wl_subsurface role. Its position as a layer replaces wl_subsurface.set_position, which is ignored while the layer object exists.

request.name: set_text_input_cursor_rectangle

description.summary: pending: associate a text cursor with an animated layer

request.description:
root is the text-input-v3 focused root surface, which has no subsurface parent. layer must be a live layer below root, owned by the same client. x, y, width and height describe the cursor in layer-local logical pixels; width and height must be positive. The keyboard/text-input focus remains on root. This does not enable text input or transmit surrounding text.
Applied with root's wl_surface.commit. While text input is active on root, this rectangle overrides text-input-v3's cursor rectangle: Hyalo maps it through the layer's presented transform every frame and updates the input-method popup and its text_input_rectangle event accordingly. The client must not send layer-local coordinates to text-input-v3.
A null layer clears the association (the rectangle arguments are ignored), restoring text-input-v3's latest root-local rectangle. Destruction of the layer also clears it; a replacement layer object does not inherit it. The client clears it when focus changes to a field outside that layer. Like the rest of this draft, clients and Hyalo must be updated together.

interface.name: nidara_layer_v1
interface.description: Every request is double-buffered and applied with the surface's commit — for a subsurface in sync mode, with its parent's, so a window's layers, their materials and its buffer change in one commit.

entry.name: invalid_value
entry.summary: a non-finite, negative scale, opacity outside 0..1, or a curve that cannot end

request.name: destroy

description.summary: the surface stops being a layer

request.description: It stays where it was presented; its running transitions are cancelled.

request.name: set_spring_transition

description.summary: pending: the next change of a property moves on a spring

request.description: Applies to the next set_position, set_scale or set_opacity of that property only. A spring retargeted mid-flight keeps its presented velocity; initial_velocity is used only when it starts from rest, in the property's units per second.

request.name: set_curve_transition

description.summary: pending: the next change of a property moves on a cubic Bézier

request.description: A timing curve from (0,0) to (1,1) through (x1,y1) and (x2,y2), over duration_ms. Retargeted mid-flight, it starts again from the presented value.

request.name: set_position

description.summary: pending: the model position, relative to the parent surface

request.description: Logical coordinates of the layer's top-left corner. With no transition pending for position, the change is immediate.

request.name: set_scale

description.summary: pending: the model scale, uniform, about an anchor

request.description: anchor_x and anchor_y are layer-local logical coordinates; they change at once, never animated.

event.name: done

description.summary: a transition reached its model value

event.description: tv_sec_hi, tv_sec_lo and tv_nsec are the presentation time of the frame that showed its end, as in wp_presentation.

description.summary: a transition was replaced by a new model value before it ended
